conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; source-observed copy/removal asymmetry with conditional visible consequence
conditional_findings.classification: New95e source reassessment connected to earlier Adler245 and Segovb541 removal questions; no new historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: TacticalGameplayCamera optional environment/atmosphere components and the retained strategic camera synchronization owner.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The camera-copy path inserts optional environment components when present, but neither detects absence as a change nor removes stale target components when the gameplay camera loses them.
conditional_findings.trace: sync_environment observes optional Ref<EnvironmentMapLight> and Ref<AtmosphereSettings>, considers only present changed values, and inserts each only on Some. For non-map targets it never removes either on None; a map target explicitly removes AtmosphereSettings and fog, but not EnvironmentMapLight. AtmosphereIblCache::clear removes EnvironmentMapLight from the gameplay camera on a changed bake key or absence of a usable current scene/shader; cache_initialized_atmosphere also removes AtmosphereSettings when atmosphere is disabled. Live ViewCameras and pooled SnapshotCamera entities can be retained and reused. A removed gameplay component therefore does not itself clear the prior target component; even another tracked change or a reinserted marker reaches the same Some-only insertion logic.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: Replacement-scene mesh visibility waits for installation, and capture settlement only advances while complete assets are ready; a later successful bake can insert a new map and be copied. The visibility gate deliberately remains open for later rebakes, but a real supported same-root rebake, specific camera timing, old/new lighting result or visible artifact was not observed. Graphics settings appear initialized from config; no production in-place enable/disable writer was established. Atmosphere-disabled startup alone does not prove a previously populated target.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit and separate implementation authorization, define explicit present/absent propagation and change detection for each source optional component, preserving the intentional regional-map exception and the correct new-bake, camera reuse and capture lifecycles.
acceptance_requirements: A retained strategic camera has the intended environment and atmosphere component state across supported source insertion, removal, rebake, reuse and map modes, with readiness gates preserving their intended behavior.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; exact remove/copy source paths and safeguards traced; supported same-root transitions, schedule, native rendering and aliases remain open

conditional_findings.classification: New95e idealized source-level camera geometry question connected to prior Street/viewport scope; no historical finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Street full-size frontage target, vertical field of view and browser full-rectangle framing.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The camera aims at 45% of street height from an eye 1.7m above the frontage, while vertical FOV assumes a symmetric half-height around its view ray; for some height/width ratios a point at the frontage ground can fall below the field.
conditional_findings.trace: Street::arrange uses width at least18m per bay, height at least18m and height=max(current, collision extent.y+8m). distance=width/2/tan(80 degrees/2); the camera looks from ground+1.7m toward ground+0.45*height, and vertical_fov=2*atan(height/2/distance). The generated flat frontage plane is at ground+0.01m. Browser streetWindow derives full-rectangle bay widths from width/height and retains the full camera projection while clipping.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: For a hypothetical one-bay street width18m and height30m (consistent with a22m collision extent and no more than14m width before the4m bay gap), ideal real-number trigonometry gives distance about10.7258m, optical elevation47.7303 degrees, half FOV54.4333 degrees and lower edge -6.7030 degrees. A ground-plane point at the front-centre has angle about -8.9542 degrees, roughly2.25 degrees below that edge. This computes source formulas only; it constructs no building, camera, projection, canvas or pixels.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: No supported generated building with that extent and bay width, actual browser rectangle or visible clipping was established. Collision extent can include buried geometry, the intended 45% target and skyline margin may deliberately prefer upper frontage, and other portions of the ground plane may still be visible. Aspect, clipping and floating-point behavior need actual contract and source-specific confirmation.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit and separate implementation authorization, decide the required vertical bounds for supported full-size frontage and derive framing from actual eye-to-bound angles or explicitly document intentional crop while preserving normal horizontal lens and scrolling behavior.
acceptance_requirements: Supported frontage geometry satisfies a stated framing policy at the full camera rectangle; intentional cropping and any tall/narrow exceptions are explicit.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; ideal symbolic counterexample and browser layout relation recorded, valid generated inputs, viewport/rendering and exact aliases remain open
